tasks.title: WHAT THE DOOR EVENT PROVES
tasks.prompt: What does the 18:17 door event establish by itself?

options.text: Badge B-204 was used to enter the archive
The envelope was already missing before 18:00

tasks.explanation: DE-03 records badge B-204 only; the controller note says it does not identify the carrier.

tasks.title: THE RETURN AND THE SCAN
tasks.prompt: Which records establish that Ishaan returned B-204 before the archive entry?

options.text: The signed return at 17:24 and the later temporary scan by Maya

tasks.title: THE CABLE REQUEST
tasks.prompt: Which alternative suspect is weakened by the equipment-request trail, and why?

options.text: Arjun; the replacement cable came from the AV cabinet, not the archive
Ishaan; he requested the cable from the archive
Maya; her own badge was used at 18:17

tasks.explanation: ER-01 was fulfilled from the AV cabinet with no archive stock movement, which weakens the case against Arjun.

tasks.title: CUSTODY OF B-204
tasks.prompt: Who had documented custody of B-204 after its signed return and before the archive entry?
tasks.explanation: After the signed return the badge custody trail shows only Maya taking B-204, at 17:31, and no return to the desk.
reference_sql: SELECT event_at,actor_id,event_type,from_location,to_location FROM sql04_badge_custody WHERE badge_id='B-204' ORDER BY event_at

tasks.title: THE BEST EXPLANATION
tasks.prompt: Which explanation best fits the complete evidence?

options.text: Maya used the badge after taking custody of it, removed the envelope to delay handover, then amended the note to point blame at Ishaan.
Ishaan kept his badge and removed the envelope after his shift.
Arjun took the envelope while collecting the cable from the AV cabinet.
Pooja removed the envelope when she requested a handover check.

tasks.explanation: Maya’s custody, her 18:11 amended note, the 18:26 hold-the-handover message and her 18:51 blame of Ishaan fit together; none of the other options explains all of them.
reference_sql: SELECT sent_at,sender_id,message_text FROM sql04_messages ORDER BY sent_at
